components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The core Ubon Green action for searches, submits, and approvals.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #116045; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d4e38; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(17,96,69,0.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Public Input
components.description: Warm filled input used by filters, search, and planning forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888; } .ds-input { background: #f4f2ee; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; color: #111; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #116045; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17,96,69,0.08); background: #fff; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact pill for category and trip-size selection.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: #555; background: #eeece8; border: 1.5px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.16s, color 0.16s, background 0.16s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #116045; color: #116045; } .ds-chip-active { background: rgba(17,96,69,0.1); border-color: #116045; color: #116045; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Place Card
components.description: Image-led destination card for exploration lists.
components.html:
Photo

components.css: .ds-place-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #eae8e3; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; color: #111; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-place-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-place-img { height: 150px; background: #e8e6e1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #888; font-size: 13px; } .ds-place-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-place-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-place-tag { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 100px; background: rgba(17,96,69,0.08); color: #116045; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-place-body p { margin: 0; color: #888; font-size: 12px; }

components.description: Compact top navigation link on the fixed green navbar.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: #116045; padding: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #fff; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #fff; }

narrative.overview: Teawinai is a product UI for turning local travel knowledge into useful trip decisions. The design should feel simple, trustworthy, and modern: a calm console for finding places, planning around budget and location, and keeping place data accurate.
keyCharacteristics: Thai-first sans typography with a compact product scale.
Ubon Green as the single brand and action accent.
Flat surfaces by default, with soft lift only on interactive or image-led cards.
Clear state language for filters, approval queues, forms, tables, and errors.
Public pages stay approachable; admin pages stay dense and task-focused.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ubon Green is the only brand accent. Do not add a competing blue, purple, or booking-app orange for primary UI.

rules.name: The Surface Split Rule
rules.body: Public discovery screens use light warm surfaces. Admin and review workflows use dark operational surfaces. Do not mix both moods inside the same task area.

rules.name: The Product Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep typography fixed and compact on task screens. Fluid type belongs only to hero and page-level display moments.

rules.name: The Resting Flat Rule
rules.body: Cards are bordered and flat at rest. Lift appears in response to hover, overlay context, or hero layering.

dos: Do use Ubon Green for primary actions, active filters, progress, and approval state.
Do keep public discovery surfaces light, readable, and image-led.
Do keep admin surfaces dense, dark, and operational.
Do use Noto Sans Thai across the interface for consistent Thai rendering.
donts: Don't make Teawinai look or feel like a hotel-booking app.
Don't use room-search patterns, deal badges, reservation pressure, luxury-travel polish, or generic travel marketplace templates.
Don't make local recommendations feel like advertisements instead of useful community knowledge.
Don't add competing primary colors for core actions. The Tailwind blue scale is not the product identity.
